The claim is not true — a statement that fails to correspond to fact. This is a frame-relative assessment (a claim may be refuted in one standpoint and unequivocal in another); it is NOT a global truth verdict ([Principle 11](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-11)).
